habitat_design.rationale: Donkeys are hardy grazers long domesticated alongside farms and pastures, thriving on open grassland and cultivated land near people rather than deep wilderness.

content.fact_text: Donkeys have big, sensitive ears that help them hear really well, and their loud hee-haw call can travel up to 3 kilometers to reach faraway friends! They live together in cozy herds and love to rest in the shade during the hottest part of the day.

checklist_log.source: Drawn from animaldiversity.org's Equus asinus (ass) account, which covers donkey hearing, hee-haw calls carrying up to 3 km, herd social structure, and resting behavior in hot afternoons.
checklist_log.tone: pass - warm and playful, focuses on friendship and comfort (cozy herds, resting in shade)
checklist_log.predation: pass - no predation, death, or threat framing; describes hearing and social behavior only
